title: Fixed Front Bore and Rear Crank Pencil Sharpener
description: One original complete static manual desktop pencil-sharpener appearance. A low chamfered grounded foot supports a closed collection-case exterior and a short horizontal drum housing. The front circular face has an actual narrow blind pencil-entry channel with complete inner wall and floor, surrounded by a separate annular guide rim. A rear stub shaft carries a full offset crank arm and separate faceted axial grip. A small front collection-case pull belongs to the whole tool. Three opaque untextured PBR materials. Not the vertical open-hopper coffee hand mill or handheld hair dryer relabelled. One prop and zero scenes. Fixed pose only; no pencil, exposed cutting elements, internal mechanism, chip path, working crank action, sharpening procedure, fit specification, output quality or safety claim. The front bore is intentionally blind, not an assembled through-channel.
